title: Rational analytic syntomic cohomology
summary: We define and study the rational analytic syntomification $X^{\mathrm{Syn}}$ of a partially proper rigid-analytic variety $X$ over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. We establish Poincaré duality and a theory of first Chern classes for the resulting cohomology theory, identify vector bundles on $X^{\mathrm{Syn}}$ with de Rham bundles on the Fargues--Fontaine curve of $X^{\diamondsuit}$ and recover several classical comparison theorems in $p$-adic Hodge theory. We also develop analogues of our results and constructions over $\mathbb{C}_p$.
